program.ge_pattern: Local General Education (specific to the Nursing Program)
outcomes: Students will be able to prioritize safe, quality nursing care incorporating application of the nursing process to diverse patients across the lifespan in a variety of health care settings.

Students will be able to exercise nursing judgment through application of critical thinking, clinical reasoning, and evidence-based practice to promote the health of patients in a family and community context.
Students will be able to participate in quality improvement processes to improve patient care outcomes.

Students will be able to initiate communication and interdisciplinary collaboration with members of the healthcare team, patient and the patient’s support system to facilitate improved patient outcomes.

Students will be able to utilize the appropriate information management systems and patient care technology to communicate within an interdisciplinary team, manage knowledge, mitigate error and support decision making in the clinical environment.
Students will be able to analyze professional identity through leadership and a commitment to caring, diversity, ethics, excellence, holism, integrity, and patient-centered care.

notes: The printed total of 77.5 units includes the 16-unit Local General Education requirement (16 prerequisites + 38.5 core + 16 GE + 7 electives), so it is recorded as degree_total; the page prints no separate major total, and 'Complete a minimum of 21 semester units in a major' is a generic minimum, not this award's total.

'Program Electives 7' (also 'Nursing Program Electives= 7 units') is printed outside every block with no course list; recorded as open_elective_units, but the page does not say these are open to any course. Reviewer should check whether they are restricted nursing electives.
Core block reads 'Complete the following number of rules: 16' over 16 courses, recorded as all required.
Catalog prints codes without spaces (e.g., BIO032, ENGLC1000, NURS016); these match closed-list BIO 32, ENGL C1000, NURS 16, etc.
Local GE courses (CHEM 002A, PSYC C1000, STAT C1000, SOC 001/002, COMM C1000, Arts/Humanities, Ethnic Studies) are not placed in blocks as they are general education.
The text is cut off mid-word in PSLO 7 ('in a varie'); the outcome is recorded as printed, truncated.
Source URL refers to 'nursing-as-fall-2025' while the catalog year is 2026-2027; reviewer may confirm the catalog year.
